# Repository Label Taxonomy

This document defines the standard label taxonomy utilized to categorize issues and pull requests inside the repository.

---

## Standard Labels

- **`bug`**: System malfunctions or unexpected execution errors.
- **`enhancement`**: Minor refactorings, optimizations, or layout updates.
- **`feature`**: New functional capabilities or customer user stories.
- **`documentation`**: Updates to specs, changelogs, roadmaps, or templates.
- **`architecture`**: Changes affecting target architecture contracts or ADR files.
- **`security`**: Modifications impacting RLS policies, Vault cryptography, or encryption keys.
- **`performance`**: Changes optimizing file processing times or database queries.
- **`technical debt`**: Clean-ups of legacy code warnings or deprecated variables.
- **`blocked`**: Work halted due to upstream dependencies or architectural questions.
- **`ready for review`**: Code complete and waiting for developer code review.
- **`ready for release`**: Validated staging builds ready for production deployment.
- **`good first issue`**: Low-risk tasks suitable for new developers.
- **`help wanted`**: Complex challenges requesting architecture board inputs.
- **`AI generated`**: Pull requests or plans compiled by AI agent assistants.
- **`needs human review`**: Mandatory review gate requiring human developer verification.
